description: The layer_weights, withholding_rule, and confidence_formula values below reproduce assess_axes()'s former hardcoded Integrity weighting exactly. severe_contradiction_rules/severe_contradiction_cap are new, active-by-default behaviour, not a reproduction of prior hardcoding: a severe, near-impossible-to-fake-honestly contradiction now caps the weighted mean instead of being diluted by averaging.

layer_weight_rationale.file_integrity: Hash binding and parser success are the hardest evidence to fabricate convincingly; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.declaration_consistency: Requires matching declared fields to a file the submitter does not control; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.cross_evidence_support: Independent-source corroboration (DDEX/CompSheet/CueSheet/C2PA-ingredient); baseline weight. physical_similarity is not weightable here because it is policy-disabled (see docs/PHYSICAL_SIMILARITY.md) and never contributes to integrity; re-admitting it to scoring, and whether a higher weight is then defensible on forge-cost grounds (a convincing fabricated derivation is harder to produce than a convincing flat claim), is a separate, deliberate decision -- not something this profile does silently.
